digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown / snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: Snapshot producers in non-test_snapshot.py modules leave non-removable read-only .rebar/run_snapshots/<sha> directories in pytest basetemp because cleanup was module-local only
Production snapshots are intentionally published with 0444/0555 permissions that survive test execution and block ordinary shutil.rmtree with PermissionError
Centralized autouse fixture in tests/conftest.py must search tmp_path for exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and apply snapshot._rmtree_writable before shared teardown
Read-only production snapshot permissions must be preserved during each test and remain non-writable through the shared teardown phase
Cleanup must not remove or modify unrelated temp content adjacent to the targeted .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots
